scope: Independent contribution over the original 38-patch baseline. Baseline restores only the old App dispatch path; the added internal store method remains compiled but unused by that path. Identical fixtures and other production code; alternating-order process pairs and fixed iteration counts.
limits: App method on loopback PostgreSQL, not complete HTTP endpoint latency or production capacity.
Parallel ns/op is amortized wall time per completed operation, not per-request latency.
Real users, memberships, root posts and replies are created outside timing. Every operation checks all count fields and returned page data; threads-only controls exercise the unchanged no-count path.
These are standalone measurements, not combined-stack throughput.
